messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — I'm migrating payments-service to ExternalSecrets backed by Vault. Two quick config Qs before I open the PR:

1) For service account auth: do we keep the projected token (tokenRequest / projectedVolume) approach or switch to a long-lived kube auth role bound to a specific SA? Pros/cons?
2) Vault path layout: current pattern is secret/data/<env>/<service>/<key>, is that fine or should we use cluster-scoped paths (e.g., secret/data/<cluster>/<env>/...)?

Current plan: use ExternalSecrets with `vault.kubernetes.authPath: kubernetes` and a short TTL token via projected SA token. Wanted to surface any infra constraints.

Maria: +1 for projected tokens. avoids long-lived creds and maps well to rotation. If you use projected token approach make sure RBAC + projected token IMDS are allowed on the namespace.

Maria: Example ExternalSecret snippet I used last week:
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1m
  provider:
    vault:
      server: "https://vault.internal"
      path: "secret/data/prod/payments"
      auth:
        kubernetes:
          mountPath: "kubernetes"
          role: "payments-extsecrets-role"
```

Jon: FYI, if you go projected token make sure the SA is bound to a Kubernetes auth role in Vault and that the role's bound_service_account_namespaces is correct. We had a bug where role allowed `default` only and our ns was `payments-prod`.

Jon: Also add this to your TF overlay for the k8s rolebinding:
```
resource "kubernetes_role_binding" "payments_ext_role" {
  metadata { name = "payments-extsecrets-rolebind" namespace = var.namespace }
  role_ref { kind = "Role" name = "extsecrets-access" api_group = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io" }
  subject { kind = "ServiceAccount" name = "external-secrets" namespace = var.namespace }
}
```

Sam: rotation note — Vault token TTL + ExternalSecrets refreshInterval interplay matters. If Vault token TTL < refreshInterval you can get 401s. Recommend set TTL >= 5m + jitter.
We use jitter formula: TTL * 0.1 up to 30s. Also be mindful of the cache on the ES controller.

Eva: Small nit: for path layout, prefer cluster + env (secret/data/<cluster>/<env>/<svc>) so we can support cross-cluster staging/prod parity and easier purge by cluster. But either is fine, document it in the onboarding doc and tag owners.

Alex: thanks all — I'll adopt projected tokens, add the TF rolebinding, and switch to cluster/env path. I'll also add TTL = 15m + jitter and set ExternalSecret refreshInterval = 1m.

Alex: opening the draft PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4567 — please poke for review. cc @Maria @Jon

Jon: reviewing now. quick check: make sure the Vault role has `bound_service_account_namespaces = ["payments-prod"]` and `bound_service_account_names = ["external-secrets-sa"]` so impersonation is locked down.

Maria: Also add a short smoke test in the post-deploy job that does `kubectl get secret payments-credentials -n payments-prod -o yaml` and validate keys exist. Saves on flakiness.

infra-bot: PR 4567 moved to merged by infra-bot (check CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/4567).

Sam: merging looks good, but I'll run a quick canary against staging cluster in 30m and post results.

Eva: thanks everyone! If there are any secrets mapping edgecases, ping me and I'll update the docs in /docs/ops/secrets-mapping.md :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll follow up with an onboarding doc update and link the PR. Thanks :heart:
